scope: Phase5 authoritative pre-claim owned conversation baseline and isolated typed recovery runtime composition

compiledRuntime.mode: actual stored completed checkpoint -> actual pre-claim baseline capture -> actual task/companion receipt -> actual delivery ledger with simulated HTTP -> typed composition reads all sources -> actual SQL closure -> emitted handoff
compiledRuntime.inputCheckpoint: fixture-seeded completed mixed checkpoint, no production-history certification

productionRouting: Only isolated recovery composition is connected internally; production JS foreground/router/scheduler remain active
limitations: Runtime composition covers recovery, not full foreground inference/approval/presentation/delivery orchestration.
Baseline producer accepts completed mixed checkpoints or verified active-run handoffs; legacy/reminder-only continuity needs separate migration.
A baseline-only interrupted turn requires separate recovery; lost capture replies are not automatically retried.
Only exact-UUID task complete/delete effects and manifest-based text delivery are covered by the composed proof producers.
Checkpoint input is fixture-seeded and provider HTTP acceptance responses are simulated. No production history or handset delivery is certified.
Concurrent first capture/foreground execution is not separately tested.
Backend direct SQL is trusted; semantic validation is performed by the host, not exclusively by SQL.
No Supabase SDK service-role round trip, production activation/migration or provider/WhatsApp call occurred.
Full maintained JS conversion, declaration retirement, broader legacy SDK WebAuthn/TS7 compatibility, supported builds and live provider/rollout gates remain open.
rollback: Disable isolated baseline capture/recovery composition; retain immutable baselines, original checkpoints, task/delivery receipts and engine namespace fences.
